# Chime Health — combo checkout (GLP-1 + BONUS FREE NAD+), V2: working copy for the redesign

Client request, 2026-09-21: "do a clone of this landing
(`chime-checkout-bonus/product.html#med-tirz`) in a new folder" — the redesign happens here, the
original stays as it is.

**This folder is a detached copy, not a build output.** `chime-checkout-bonus/` is regenerated by
`uploads/inv-checkout-flow/build-chime-checkout.py bonus`; this folder is NOT a mode of that
script — re-running it never touches these files, so hand-edit freely. At clone time the two
folders differed only in `?v=` and the folder name in the file header comments; what changed since is
in the redesign log below.

    product.html  →  checkout.html        (same two steps, same relative links)

## Redesign log

- **2026-09-21 — hero + results merged** (Luis: "combine the 2 section with the 6th one, decrease the 2
  section information"). The hero and the "Why is everyone switching to Chime?" section are one block,
  `section.hero-merge`: headline, bonus ribbon, the three results (2x / -14 lbs / 94.8%), the
  recommendation card, the button and the self-reported-data footnote next to the members photo
  (desktop: copy left, photo right; phone: results and photo side by side). Dropped from the hero:
  the Today / With Chime silhouettes, the weight / BMI / cravings table (stand-in numbers), the
  "Our recommendation" heading and the 94.6% strip. The old results section is gone from further
  down — the page is ~1,150px shorter at 1440. Every other section is byte-identical to the original.
  Styles: `css/redesign.css` (new, loaded last — all redesign CSS goes there).
- **2026-09-21 — plans moved up** (Luis: "move Ready to achieve your Goal? We are! section to 4th
  place"). `#products` now follows the next steps (it was 7th, after delivery); the block itself is
  unchanged. Order: header → hero + results → next steps → **plans** → meds + support → members →
  delivery → FAQ. `#products` / `#med-sema` / `#med-tirz` and the plan scripts work as before.

## Preview

    cd ~/Sites/chime && python3 -m http.server 8791

then http://localhost:8791/chime-checkout-bonus-v2/product.html → `checkout.html`.
`product.html#med-tirz` opens on the Tirzepatide card, `#med-sema` on Semaglutide.

## Layout

| | |
|---|---|
| `css/1p1s7yzodipl6.css`, `2_6-q88y6yuc5.css`, `36xz9kx5hwvks.css`, `extracted-inline.css` | the reference's compiled sheets — restyle by overriding, not by editing them |
| `css/chime-theme.css` | the Chime theme over those sheets |
| `css/plan-stage.css` | the plan rows inside each medication card (product page only) |
| `css/redesign.css` | the redesign's own styles, loaded last (hero-merge) |
| `css/bonus.css` | everything the combo offer adds (ribbon, combo tile, why-both strip, callouts) — both pages |
| `js/plan-select.js` | plan rows → the pick, saved to `sessionStorage` (`chime:checkout-selection`) |
| `js/checkout-selection.js`, `js/checkout.js` | the order summary filled from that pick |

The `sessionStorage` key is the one every `chime-checkout*` folder uses, so a plan picked on the
original carries into this copy in the same tab and the other way round. Harmless; rename it in
both js files if the redesign changes what is stored.

Trap carried from the original: the compiled sheets pad every `img[src*="images/vial-"]` by 6%,
so a small vial thumb needs its `padding` overridden or it renders as a blank tile.

## ⚠️ Stand-ins carried over (unchanged from the original)

- **Prices are the 1 + 3 ladder.** Semaglutide $299/mo monthly, $249/mo on 3 months + 1 free
  ($747 due today); Tirzepatide $359 / $299 ($897 due today). No combo price points were given.
- **The NAD+ value is $299** everywhere, as the client wrote it. The NAD+ product page on the site
  quotes a different figure.
- **Copy.** The "why both" claims are marketing copy in Chime voice, not clinical statements.
- What is still RemedyMeds and flagged is documented in `chime-checkout/README.md`.
